author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Job interviews apparently have a new secret test: reject the candidate and see whether they’re willing to argue, overcome the objection and convince you to hire them anyway.
 
Because apparently accepting “no” like a normal person means you failed the interview.
In this video, we're looking at recruiters, hiring managers, job interviews, sales interviews, headhunters, résumé advice and some of the increasingly ridiculous mind games job seekers are expected to navigate just to get hired.

One hiring manager says fewer than 1% of candidates pass his interview test.
At the end of the interview, he tells candidates they aren't a good fit.
Most people politely accept the rejection and leave.

Apparently that's the wrong answer.
The candidate is supposed to challenge the decision, ask why they're being rejected and sell the interviewer on why the company is wrong.

title: CEOS WANT YOU TO BEG FOR JOBS NOW!
